limits: Cases are authored by the checker authors; the set was written before the hardening so the baseline is genuine, but a clean result is necessary, not sufficient.
Not model output: Tier 1/2 rewriters have never run (F-06). The real false-accept rate on SLM text is unmeasured.
Tamil coverage is a 25-sentence hand-written lexicon check; it needs a native-speaker review before any Tamil explanation ships.
50 of the must-reject cases are templated cross-products and add volume, not diversity.
